entries.603db34b7d1e96b9: A reportable segment handling mainly household sewing machines, as well as embroidery machines and related software. Developed and manufactured by the company, JANOME Taiwan Co., Ltd. and JANOME Thailand Co., Ltd., and sold by the company and subsidiaries such as JANOME America Co., Ltd., JANOME UK Co., Ltd. and JANOME Australia Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥29,787 million.
entries.ade17eddac9bd221: Household sewing machines are the core product of the business. Developed and manufactured by the company and its Taiwan and Thailand subsidiaries, and sold through sales subsidiaries and others around the world.
entries.c19af071b7cef88e: A manufacturer centered on household sewing machines, which also handles industrial equipment and IT services.
